ops.body: Root-cause correction after deeper triage: this is NOT (only) a push race. Evidence: (1) Guides was green on every push through 8c1f515 (06:20) and fails on all three viz-work commits (e7c2323, 9fc6e7b, abdbbb9) including a rerun of abdbbb9's job with zero concurrent pushes — deterministic, 3x "push rejected — refetching" then "could not land the re-render". (2) No new cc-guides release since v0.1.49 (07-23) — CI's renderer version matches the green runs'. (3) A fresh depth-2 clone of main at abdbbb9 + local `cc-guides ci-render` with the same v0.1.49 produces ZERO diff — rendered files are in sync with fragments. So the render/push failure is CI-environment-specific (whatever ci-render commits or pushes there doesn't exist locally), and debugging belongs in the cc-guides repo: instrument the ci-render job to print `git status --porcelain` + the exact rejected ref/error before the retry loop. All substantive cc-notes CI (CI, cc-notes, Autobump) is green on abdbbb9.
